description: This file is an API wrapper module for authentication-related backend endpoints. It provides functions to login and logout by making POST requests to specified API endpoints, handling tokens and roles as part of the backend response.

methods.name: loginApi({ username, password })
methods.description: Performs login by posting username and password to /auth/login, returns the server response including token and role.

methods.name: logoutApi()
methods.description: Performs logout by posting to /auth/logout; errors are caught and ignored to ensure a best-effort logout.
